description: Phase 3 — Manifest V3 Browser Extension: implement manifest.json, service_worker.js, content_script.js, page-main.js, popup.html, popup.js, popup.css. This is pure JavaScript/HTML/CSS — no Python, no build step. Depends on FEAT-001 for directory structure only. Independent of all Python FEATs.
steps: Create src/extension/manifest.json at /home/williamdeldaymarketing/Projects/Google Notebook MCP/src/extension/manifest.json. Fields: manifest_version:3, name:'Gemini Notebook MCP Bridge', version:'0.1.0', description:'Browser-resident execution broker for the Gemini Notebook MCP gateway.', background:{service_worker:'service_worker.js',type:'module'}, content_scripts:[{matches:['https://notebook.google.com/*','https://notebooklm.google.com/*'],js:['content_script.js'],run_at:'document_idle',world:'ISOLATED'}], permissions:['nativeMessaging','scripting','tabs','alarms','storage'], host_permissions:['https://notebook.google.com/*','https://notebooklm.google.com/*'], action:{default_popup:'popup.html',default_title:'Gemini Notebook MCP'}, icons:{16:'icons/icon16.png',48:'icons/icon48.png',128:'icons/icon128.png'}. NOTE: no 'cookies' permission — zero cookie access.

Create src/extension/service_worker.js at /home/williamdeldaymarketing/Projects/Google Notebook MCP/src/extension/service_worker.js. Implement: (a) CONSTANTS: NATIVE_HOST_NAME='com.mcp.gemini.broker', NOTEBOOK_ORIGINS=['https://notebook.google.com','https://notebooklm.google.com'], KEEP_ALIVE_ALARM='keepalive', KEEP_ALIVE_INTERVAL_MINUTES=0.5 (30 seconds), TAB_COOLDOWN_MS=60000. (b) Module-level state: nativePort (chrome.runtime.Port|null), provisionedTabId (number|null), tabCreatedAt (number). (c) chrome.alarms.onAlarm listener — on KEEP_ALIVE_ALARM name, call ensureNativePort() as a no-op keep-alive. (d) chrome.runtime.onStartup + onInstalled listeners — call chrome.alarms.create(KEEP_ALIVE_ALARM, {periodInMinutes: KEEP_ALIVE_INTERVAL_MINUTES}). (e) function ensureNativePort() — if nativePort null or disconnected, opens chrome.runtime.connectNative(NATIVE_HOST_NAME), attaches onMessage and onDisconnect handlers. (f) chrome.runtime.onMessage listener from content_script — handles 'page_ready' message (tab has WIZ_global_data), stores authuser. (g) function ensureNotebookTab() -> Promise<chrome.tabs.Tab> — queries for existing tab matching NOTEBOOK_ORIGINS; if found returns it; else creates new tab {url: 'https://notebook.google.com/', pinned:true, active:false}, stores provisionedTabId and tabCreatedAt; awaits DOM ready signal via chrome.tabs.onUpdated + executeScript polling for WIZ_global_data.SNlM0e existence (up to 15s, 500ms interval). (h) function injectPageMain(tabId: number) -> Promise<void> — calls chrome.scripting.executeScript({target:{tabId}, files:['page-main.js'], world:'MAIN'}). (i) nativePort onMessage handler — receives command from native host (JSON), calls ensureNotebookTab(), injects page-main.js, sends command via window.postMessage to content_script, awaits response message from content_script, forwards response back to nativePort. Commands: 'batchexecute', 'query_stream', 'scotty_upload'. (j) Tab recycling — on 'page_result' or timeout, if tab was provisioned by extension AND (Date.now() - tabCreatedAt) > TAB_COOLDOWN_MS, calls chrome.tabs.remove(provisionedTabId). (k) Zero cookie access — no chrome.cookies API calls anywhere. Never log message bodies or headers.

Create src/extension/content_script.js at /home/williamdeldaymarketing/Projects/Google Notebook MCP/src/extension/content_script.js. Runs in ISOLATED world. Implement: (a) window.addEventListener('message', handler) — accepts messages from page-main.js with source=='page_main_result', forwards to service_worker via chrome.runtime.sendMessage. (b) chrome.runtime.onMessage listener — accepts commands from service_worker with destination=='page_main', forwards to page via window.postMessage({source:'mcp_bridge_cmd', ...command}). (c) On DOMContentLoaded, sends chrome.runtime.sendMessage({type:'content_script_ready', url:location.href}). Never accesses window.WIZ_global_data directly (wrong world).

Create src/extension/page-main.js at /home/williamdeldaymarketing/Projects/Google Notebook MCP/src/extension/page-main.js. Injected into MAIN world. Implement: (a) function getAuthContext() -> {snlm0e: string, fdrfje: string, authuser: number, accountEmail: string} — reads window.WIZ_global_data.SNlM0e (CSRF 'at'), window.WIZ_global_data.FdrFJe (f.sid), extracts authuser N from window.location.pathname.match(/\/u\/(\d+)\/) (default 0), reads window.WIZ_global_data.oM1Kwf for account email. Returns frozen object. Never posts these values back in any response — they stay in page context only. (b) async function executeBatchexecute(rpcId: string, paramsJson: string, notebookId: string|null) -> object — calls getAuthContext(), builds form body (f.req=[[[rpcId, paramsJson, null, 'generic']]}&at={snlm0e}), appends authuser={N} to URL if N>0, calls fetch(BATCHEXECUTE_URL, {method:'POST', credentials:'include', headers:{Content-Type:..., X-Same-Domain:'1'}, body}), returns {ok:true, body: await response.text()} or {ok:false, error:{code:'FETCH_ERROR', message:..., retryable:true}}. NEVER include snlm0e, cookies, or auth headers in the returned object. (c) async function executeQueryStream(paramsJson: string) -> object — calls getAuthContext(), POSTs to QUERY_URL with f.req and at=snlm0e, reads full streamed response via response.body reader, returns {ok:true, body: fullText}. (d) async function executeScottyUpload(sourceId: string, filename: string, notebookId: string, fileBase64: string, authuser: number) -> object — step 1: fetch session URL via POST /upload/_/ with x-goog-upload-command:start headers; step 2: POST raw bytes to session URL with x-goog-upload-command:'upload, finalize'. Returns {ok:true, sourceId} or error envelope. (e) window.addEventListener('message', async handler) — responds to messages with source=='mcp_bridge_cmd', calls appropriate function, posts result back via window.postMessage({source:'page_main_result', requestId, result}). (f) Posts initial ready signal: window.postMessage({source:'page_main_result', type:'ready'}). CRITICAL: response objects must NEVER contain SNlM0e, cookie values, ya29 tokens, or raw HTTP response headers.

Create src/extension/popup.html at /home/williamdeldaymarketing/Projects/Google Notebook MCP/src/extension/popup.html. 360x480px popup. Structure: (a) head: charset, viewport, link to popup.css, title. (b) body with class 'popup-root': top-bar div (logo SVG, connection-health-badge span, account-badge span); main-viewport div (notebook-list ul — empty initially, populated by popup.js); action-bar div (connect-button, link to docs). Use semantic HTML (header, main, footer). All text strings use data-i18n attributes pointing to English fallback values. Reference Lucide icon SVGs inline for ShieldCheck, Radio, BookOpen icons.

Create src/extension/popup.css at /home/williamdeldaymarketing/Projects/Google Notebook MCP/src/extension/popup.css. Define all CSS custom properties from ui-context.md: --bg-base:#0B0F19, --bg-surface:#111827, --bg-elevated:#1F2937, --text-primary:#F9FAFB, --text-muted:#9CA3AF, --accent-primary:#3B82F6, --accent-hover:#2563EB, --border-default:#374151, --border-focus:#60A5FA, --state-success:#10B981, --state-warning:#F59E0B, --state-error:#EF4444, --font-sans:Inter,Geist Sans,system-ui, --font-mono:JetBrains Mono,Geist Mono,monospace. Body: width:360px, min-height:480px, background:var(--bg-base), color:var(--text-primary), font-family:var(--font-sans). Connection badge states: .badge--connected{color:var(--state-success)}, .badge--reconnecting{color:var(--state-warning)}, .badge--disconnected{color:var(--state-error)}. Buttons: rounded-lg (8px), background:var(--accent-primary), hover:var(--accent-hover). Cards: rounded-xl (12px), background:var(--bg-surface), border:1px solid var(--border-default). No hardcoded hex values outside the :root block.

Create src/extension/popup.js at /home/williamdeldaymarketing/Projects/Google Notebook MCP/src/extension/popup.js. Implement: (a) On DOMContentLoaded, call chrome.runtime.sendMessage({type:'get_status'}) and render ConnectionHealthBadge and AccountSelector with returned data. (b) Fetch notebook list from chrome.storage.local key 'allowlisted_notebooks' and render NotebookAllowlistCard items. (c) Connect button click handler — sends {type:'initiate_pairing'} to service_worker, updates badge. (d) All DOM manipulation via getElementById/querySelector — no innerHTML with user-derived strings (XSS prevention). (e) Display notebook IDs in --font-mono spans. Zero inline styles — use CSS classes only.

Create a placeholder icons directory and note: src/extension/icons/ needs icon16.png, icon48.png, icon128.png (128x128 PNG). Create a README.md in src/extension/icons/ explaining that placeholder PNGs must be added before loading the extension.
acceptance_criteria: src/extension/manifest.json is valid JSON with manifest_version:3 and no 'cookies' permission
page-main.js contains no console.log calls that reference SNlM0e, cookies, or auth tokens
service_worker.js contains no chrome.cookies API calls
popup.css defines all 13 CSS custom properties from ui-context.md
content_script.js and page-main.js do not share a world (content_script runs ISOLATED, page-main injected into MAIN via scripting API)
verification: python3 -c "import json; m=json.load(open('src/extension/manifest.json')); assert m['manifest_version']==3; assert 'cookies' not in m.get('permissions',[]); print('manifest OK')"

grep -L 'SNlM0e\|ya29\|SID\|HSID\|SSID' src/extension/page-main.js src/extension/service_worker.js | wc -l  # expect 2 (neither file contains those strings in log/return statements — manual audit required for context)
